common_actual_CPU.limit: min(120, all five actual external whole-child CPU seconds for this object)
common_actual_CPU.missing_policy: If any of five external CPU values is missing/nonfinite/negative, limit=null; keep all five rows unavailable in48 denominator
common_actual_CPU.eligible: Original runner eligible AND legal AND audit CPU_seconds<=limit AND audit CPU_seconds<=120
common_actual_CPU.choice: minimum original paid Phi, retain first history entry on exact Phi ties
common_actual_CPU.source: Authoritative original/extension final queue jobs[].external.child_process_CPU_seconds; never internal timer or cap substitution
common_actual_CPU.interpretation: Retrospective already-paid prefix estimate, not measured stopped deployment wall

common_physical_LU.limit: min(all five whole-job physical LU counts for this object)
common_physical_LU.source: Final run receipt physical_cost.physical_LU if present, otherwise physical_cost.LU; aggregate key only
common_physical_LU.missing_policy: If any five whole-job LU values missing/nonfinite/negative, limit=null; unavailable candidate LU cannot qualify; denominator48 retained
common_physical_LU.eligible: Original runner eligible AND legal AND audit CPU_seconds<=120 AND recorded cumulative candidate LU<=limit
common_physical_LU.choice: minimum original paid Phi, retain first history entry on exact Phi ties
common_physical_LU.interpretation: Physics-only diagnostic; projector/SVD/FFT/current iterations/setup are not free and are not equalized by this axis
